items.title: Understanding and optimizing materialized views in Amazon Redshift
items.summary: Materialized views in Amazon Redshift speed up expensive queries, but every refresh costs compute whether or not a query reads the result. This post shares a diagnostic view, v_mv_health, and the sp_populate_mv_definitions procedure that surface each MV's refresh eligibility, cost, staleness, dependencies, and usage in one result set.
items.creator: Nick Barclay
